item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Project the hour before aggregation, preserving NULL hours and COUNT(*) semantics.","sql":"SELECT hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) AS projected GROUP BY hour"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Use window counts and DISTINCT to retain one row per hour, including the NULL partition, with BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filter in a CTE before grouping, preserving the original calendar-day predicate and duplicate counts.","sql":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM eligible GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Use filtered aggregation and remove groups without qualifying rows, preserving NULL route keys and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"}]}
